resources.string: My Table is read-only. Create a table, or duplicate My Table, to start editing.
Tap the add button to search for lectures or create your own activities.
Drag the handle to make it bigger or smaller.
Tap the calendar button to hide it and see more results, and again to bring it back.
Tap the add button to add it to “%1$s”.
Touch and hold a lecture to see its details.
Share it as an image from the timetable menu.
Describe your activity, and Quick Fill adds its title, place and times.
Summarise a long review from its menu.
Translate a post, or summarise a long one, from the post menu.
Share, duplicate or edit a theme from its menu.
Tips show again the next time Buddy opens.
Reset Tips shows every tip again and starts the timetable onboarding over, as for a new user. Both settings apply the next time Buddy opens.
